decision_rule: Descriptive scoped transfer diagnostic, not full G-S, quality or production representative: require 500/500 fixed 2.2 query rows successful on both private stores and both models, matching prepublication content pins and cleanup, with per-query token lengths and top-5/top-10 cosine percentiles and threshold counts [0.1,0.3,0.4,0.6,0.7,0.75,0.85,0.9]. Report all 500 denominator and any failure/not-run rows; rc75/partial is incomplete, rc2/failed rows is failed. Compare BGE and EG2 distributions without interpreting cross-model similarity as retrieval quality. No organic query or adoption claim.
